newsitem.title: USA: Duke 846 MW Oconee nuke seen on line Monday.
newsitem.headline: Duke 846 MW Oconee nuke seen on line Monday.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 846 megawatt (MW) Oconoee nuclear power unit 2 should resume electricity production later today after beginning startup proceedures this weekend, a spokesman said Monday.
"We expect it to synchronize to the (power) grid this afternoon," spokesman Rick Zuercher said, adding "it should reach full power in several days."
The unit, located in Seneca, S.C., was shut Sept 24 after seven workers were scalded by a burst steam pipe.
The adjacent nuclear power units 1 and 3, which each also have a capacity of 846 MW, were shut Oct 4 for steam pipe inspections.
Oconee unit 1 will likely begin startup later this week or over the weekend, Zuercher said.
Oconee unit 3 should resume power production in mid-February, he said.
Duke Power has a total generating capacity of about 18,500 MW, of which the Oconee complex accounts for about 14 percent.
